detail.longDescription:
Remotely control your Bambu Lab 3D printers, explore MakerWorld’s vast library of free models, and print your favorite designs with one tap！

Remote Printer Control
- Remotely operate the machine to start and stop printing whenever needed
- Get real-time printing status and resolve errors promptly
- Access to learning resources and step-by-step instructions to fix printing problems
- High-resolution live view of the printing process
- Automatic records of the printing process to help diagnose printing failures
- Automatic timelapse video of the printing process to share with others

3D Model Discovery with MakerWorld
- Explore countless creative models and enjoy high-quality printing for free
- Find trendy works and customize your unique models with MakerLab
- Like, collect, and print in one tap to bring your ideas to life
- Interact with makers and redeem credits for Bambu products

Bambu Handy is a free 3D printing platform. We are open to any feedback and suggestions. Whether you are an expert, hobbyist or newcomer, we would like to grow together with you. Contact: https://support.bambulab.com/en
